title: Separate the known general negative, solved bipartite subcase and approximate repair
statement: Xu2609.15591v4 Theorem1.1 supplies a cubic graph for which EVERY signing has norm>2sqrt2. Its unsigned lambda2>=3-1/(2^65+1)>2sqrt2, so it is NOT a Ramanujan input. General sharp closure is refuted at that scope, while promised-base closure is not. Xu2610.09972v3 Theorem1.2 and Algorithms1-2/Section4.4 supply deterministic polynomial-BIT sharp BIPARTITE signing, with O(n^10*(log n+log d)^2) regular-case cost; bipartite derandomization must not be retrieved as unconstructed. Jadbabaie-Saberi-Sra2609.23855v1 Section6 still supplies its paid general-graph sqrt2-approximate repair, norm<2sqrt(2(d-1)), expected<100n^3 attempts. Lin-Zhou2609.15715v2 stronger existential coefficient(3+sqrt5)/2, at the stated primary normalization, does NOT supply an acquired signing selector. These source-scoped facts are complementary, not a full promised-nonbipartite sharp constructor. Root read the negative theorem/selected response and non-Ramanujan proofs, not the entire seed calculations.
